title: Vig Night
hook: Tino runs numbers out of the laundromat, and three clients suddenly forgot how counting works. Remind them, politely, that Los Serpientes have excellent memories.

objectives.text: Meet Tino behind the Suds & Spin laundromat.
Collect the late payment from the domino hall.
Shake down the mechanic skimming the till.
Drop the full envelope back to Tino.

failConditions: Police are called to the laundromat

title: Midnight Cargo
hook: A container 'fell off' a ship at Deacon's Mill and needs to vanish before the morning shift clocks in. The Combine pays well for drivers who don't ask what's rattling inside.

objectives.text: Grab the flatbed idling by the dry docks.
Load the mislabeled container at Pier 7.
Lose the harbor patrol tailing you off the causeway.
Deliver the cargo to the Combine's barn in the Glades.

title: The Skip
hook: A club promoter skipped town owing the Neon Keys a fortune and a lot of pride. Word is he's hiding in plain sight downtown. Bring him back breathing; the bruising is optional but encouraged.

objectives.text: Ask around the finance-district cafes for the promoter.
Subdue the promoter's two bodyguards in the garage.
Grab the promoter before he reaches the marina.
Deliver him to Delphine at the rooftop lounge.

title: Repossession, Paradise Style
hook: A washed-up crypto bro stopped paying on his speedboat the second CoinYak tanked. The Keys want their toy back, quietly, before he livestreams the whole thing.

objectives.text: Find the defaulted speedboat at the Keys marina.
Take the speedboat before its owner notices.
Outrun the owner's jet-ski down the coast.
Return the boat to Sal's private slip.

failConditions: The boat is sunk or wrecked

title: Block Party Insurance
hook: The Little Ayiti street festival is the best night of the year, until a crew of shakedown artists decides the food stalls owe them a 'permit fee.' Mama Estelle would like you to renegotiate.

objectives.text: Meet Mama Estelle at the community kitchen.
Run off the crew muscling the food stalls.
Hold the main stage until the parade passes.

title: Sweet Delivery
hook: The Zafra Cartel needs a package moved from a downtown high-rise to a Glades airboat dock before a rival crew intercepts it. No stops. No peeking. Tonight the clock is the only boss.

objectives.text: Pick up the sealed case from the downtown penthouse.
Shake the rival crew's SUV through the tunnels.
Reach the Glades airboat dock before midnight.

failConditions: The case is opened or scanned
The rival crew takes the package
